main_text.head: OBSEQUIAS. IVVENIS GVI-
main_text.p: Guilelmi Keithi, Illustris Domini, Guilel-mi, Comitis, Marescalli Scotiæ F. oborta rixa, Geneuæ interfecti, Memoriæ.
IEu, Guilelme, quibus lacrymis tua funera, quonam Fletu satis deplanxero?
Ne igitur pietatis amor, vitaque beata Ardore pectus succium,
Per maria & terras, Arctoa a finibus ora, Geneuam ad urbem adduxerint,
Flicto (heu facinus) scelerata vulnere dextra, Vitam Geneuæ ut poneres?
Suetumque diu pacata civibus urbis In te inchoaretur scelus?
Ec te animi virtus iuuit generosa, fuoque Par corpus ingens hospiti?
Et quem sperabant anetum spectare parentes, Corporis & animi dotibus,
Egebunt vita cassum: saltemque iacere Tellure patria velint?

page.notes: The title line is partly illegible in the scan; the first line of the poem is set as printed, with the initial "I" as a large woodcut-style initial. Some words in the verse are blurred at the left edge (cut-off fragments of the previous lines) and are transcribed as best read; doubtful readings include "succium", "anetum", "fuoque" and the first word of the second column line. Greek ἐῗ is uncertain.
